newsitem.title: USA: U.S. West Coast crudes unmoved in holiday session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. West Coast crudes unmoved in holiday session.

text.p: Fresh developments in the U.S. West Coast crude market were non-existent Friday as the U.S. Thanksgiving Day extended holiday squelched activity.
NYMEX futures trading was closed both Thursday and Friday, eliminating any sign of life in domestic cash markets.
One of the featured items for the market, when it resumes Monday, will be the status of the spot ANS market and talk of deals getting done earlier this week.
British Petroleum said Wednesday it sold 100,000 barrels of ANS at a relatively pricey $1.75 under Jan WTI/Cushing for delivery by the end of the month.
